snapshot.title: Create, edit and review items in the GUI
snapshot.description:
- Create projects, features (ready or draft) and tasks; edit title, description and parent.
- Promote draft features ("mark idea ready").
- Set status, including marking work done after review, and feature status overrides.
- Delete items (with confirmation; the service rejects items with children or dependents).
- Add decision notes.

Every write sends the revision it's based on and handles conflicts as in drag-and-drop.
